name: Solomon Islands
summary_text: Solomon Islands is dangerous for trans visitors. Same-sex conduct criminalised (14 years); no LGR; documented social hostility; weak state capacity post-Tensions; no open community infrastructure.

sources.claim_summary: ILGA World Database jurisdiction page for Solomon Islands: documents the legal status — same-sex conduct criminalised under colonial-era law, up to 14 years.

sources.title: Human Dignity Trust
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: Only the Human Dignity Trust homepage was retrievable at fetch time (no Solomon Islands-specific page); the Trust maps jurisdictions criminalising LGBT people, which include the Solomon Islands.

US State Department 2013 Human Rights Report for Solomon Islands: no security-force abuses; violence and discrimination against women prevalent; the LGBT section notes criminalisation under the penal code but no prosecutions.
US State Department 2011 Human Rights Report for Solomon Islands: documents lengthy pretrial detention, corruption, violence against women - general context; no LGBT-specific abuses reported.
US State Department 2010 Human Rights Report for Solomon Islands: documents the RAMSI assistance mission, the Lusibaea case, and general human-rights conditions - baseline assessment.

sources.title: Same sex marriage cannot populate the world, the Governor General says. | SIBC Online
sources.claim_summary: SIBC (June 2018): Governor General Sir Frank Kabui warned Solomon Islands about same-sex marriage in his Queen's birthday speech - 'Same sex marriage cannot populate the world'; noted sections 160, 161 and 162 of the Penal Code are 'the relevant prohibitions against same sex marriage and associated conduct' and challenged the country to 'remain steadfast against this onslaught'.
